integrity_statement: The scalar maximum is explicitly credited as prior work. The proved new content is the complete equality-case classification, multiplicity and parity-dependent asymptotic. Exhaustive small-case computations support but cannot substitute for the proof.
scientific_limitations: Complete optimizer classification only for finite rectangular rook graphs; not all odd induced sets or arbitrary graphs. The optimum cardinality was already public in June 2026. Full texts of two broad 2026 follow-ups were not accessible; priority of the newly enumerated optimizer family is not independently certified.
title: Parity-dependent multiplicities of maximum odd induced subgraphs in rook graphs
